en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of a small town nestled in hilly, forested countryside. Scattered farmhouses and multi‑story residential buildings line winding roads and fields in the foreground, with dense woods and a rising hill in the background. A church with a pointed steeple stands among the buildings. At the upper left, printed text reads "SCHMIEDEBERG im Erzgeb." indicating the town name and region.
